speaker: Eli
text: Reviewing document rendering for engineering notebooks. Topics: tenancy, exports, deployment; we will bounce around.

speaker: Sana
text: Need 99.9 percent monthly availability and exports under 30 seconds for a 200-page notebook.

speaker: Victor
text: Current is one shared database. We are designing target, not documenting that as target.

speaker: Eli
text: Tenancy option one: separate schema per organization.

speaker: Sana
text: Option two is shared tables with organization_id on every row and database row-level security.

speaker: Victor
text: Second option is easier migrations if every query uses RLS.

speaker: Eli
text: Tentatively shared tables plus RLS, security review required.

speaker: Sana
text: Exports use a worker queue so HTTP does not hold PDF render open.

speaker: Victor
text: Could use existing Redis queue, but it is best effort.

speaker: Eli
text: Not Redis; durable jobs matter. Existing RabbitMQ is operated by platform.

speaker: Sana
text: Agreed: RabbitMQ queue, workers render PDF into object storage, API returns job id.

speaker: Victor
text: Link expires after 24 hours?

speaker: Sana
text: Yes, signed download URL valid 24 hours. File retained seven days for retry.

speaker: Eli
text: Object store is S3-compatible in each region.

speaker: Victor
text: Deployment, workers run in Kubernetes?

speaker: Sana
text: Yes, existing Kubernetes, separate worker deployment from API.

speaker: Eli
text: Back to tenancy. Does RLS cover background workers too?

speaker: Victor
text: Only if worker sets org context from durable job before reading notebook rows.

speaker: Sana
text: That one, shared-table option, needs org context enforced in each job. I will write threat model.

speaker: Eli
text: Tentative pending review. Sana owns threat model by next Wednesday.

speaker: Victor
text: Backups: daily database snapshot plus WAL archive.

speaker: Sana
text: RPO one hour, recovery time four hours.

speaker: Eli
text: Accepted. Encrypt snapshots and test restore quarterly.

speaker: Victor
text: Could export worker read from replica?

speaker: Sana
text: Maybe, but replica lag may omit fresh edits.

speaker: Eli
text: Keep reads on primary for now; no replica decision.

speaker: Victor
text: For queue, split by organization?

speaker: Sana
text: No, one durable queue, each message carries org and notebook IDs.

speaker: Eli
text: Accepted one queue, fair scheduling avoids one org starving others.

speaker: Victor
text: Mixing exports and tenancy again. Auth is not ready.

speaker: Eli
text: Identity provider migration is deferred to next meeting; do not decide today.

speaker: Sana
text: Current export auth uses existing session tokens, no change.

speaker: Victor
text: Should diagram show identity provider as external dependency?

speaker: Eli
text: No, auth migration is deferred and current auth unchanged, keep topic out of target diagram.

speaker: Sana
text: Wait, export link can be forwarded. Require user auth on download; signed URL alone is not enough.

speaker: Victor
text: API validates session then streams from object storage.

speaker: Eli
text: Accepted: 24-hour link identifies export, download requires auth. No public bearer links.

speaker: Sana
text: Back to tenancy. Security review says RLS policies are hard to audit across every table.

speaker: Victor
text: Separate schema gives clearer boundaries but migrations slower.

speaker: Eli
text: Stop calling shared tables tentative. Choose schema per org for v1, with migration tooling.

speaker: Sana
text: Agreed. Separate schema per org. Shared rows plus RLS rejected due to policy coverage risk.

speaker: Victor
text: Does that alter queue design?

speaker: Sana
text: No, job carries org id, worker selects schema from it.

speaker: Eli
text: Update component note, same worker pool, isolated schemas.

speaker: Victor
text: Backups per schema or whole database?

speaker: Sana
text: Whole regional database snapshots, restore tooling can select schema later.

speaker: Eli
text: Accepted, whole DB snapshots and WAL. Quarterly restore test remains.

speaker: Victor
text: S3 retention seven days, signed link 24 hours. Conflict?

speaker: Sana
text: No, link validity and object retention differ.

speaker: Eli
text: Exactly.

speaker: Victor
text: Export worker concurrency?

speaker: Sana
text: Start at 12 per region, tune after load test.

speaker: Eli
text: Tentative cap 12 workers pending benchmark.

speaker: Victor
text: No need to add autoscaler now.

speaker: Sana
text: I own threat model next Wednesday. Victor, test restore?

speaker: Victor
text: I will document restore runbook by Friday.

speaker: Eli
text: I own export load test by next Tuesday.

speaker: Sana
text: I can do benchmark instead; Eli has migration review.

speaker: Eli
text: Okay, Sana owns export load test next Tuesday; I own migration review Friday.

speaker: Victor
text: I will not take queue fairness instrumentation this sprint.

speaker: Eli
text: No action assigned for that now.

speaker: Sana
text: Identity provider choice deferred to next meeting, no owner yet.

speaker: Eli
text: Yes, parked, no decision.

speaker: Victor
text: Anything else on backups?

speaker: Sana
text: Restore point one hour, recovery four. Quarterly test.

speaker: Sana
text: I checked export failure behavior: failed render jobs stay in RabbitMQ for three retries, then move to dead-letter queue.

speaker: Eli
text: Agreed, three retries and dead-letter queue, alert on-call. Still one queue setup, not a new service.

speaker: Victor
text: Can worker use same schema migration tool as API?

speaker: Sana
text: Yes, same versioned migration package, deployment order is API then workers.

speaker: Eli
text: Auth migration stays deferred; export auth does not change identity provider.

speaker: Victor
text: Backup restore test should include selecting one organization schema, not just full database.

speaker: Sana
text: Agreed, Victor add that to Friday runbook.

speaker: Eli
text: Sana owns load test next Tuesday and threat model next Wednesday.

speaker: Victor
text: We can decide autoscaling after benchmark; 12 remains tentative.

speaker: Eli
text: No other decision. Identity provider remains for next meeting.

speaker: Sana
text: Export links require auth even when signed identifier is forwarded.

speaker: Eli
text: Closing the longer review.
